dialogue_texts: Ah... ah... The heavy wall around my mind... it's shattered? I feel so light...
The boundary of your isolation has been successfully dissolved.
Now, be a good girl and tell me: who gave you that counterfeit sense of order?
It was... a lady in dark gothic clothes.
She came from the direction of Mayohiga - a world where people don't interact is a world without pain...
To think someone would attempt to enforce artificial stagnation near Mayohiga... how bold.
If the mastermind is operating around Mayohiga...
Your gaps will allow us to bypass any obstacles and catch her off guard!
Fufufu, standard flight will do for now; I prefer to enjoy the scenery of a collapsing boundary.
Let us pay a visit to Mayohiga, Shirogane-sama.
